caption: Process 1042 runs a video and calls read() on a slow SD card, so its PCB moves Running → Waiting → Ready, never straight back to Running. Notice the saved PC is 0x2A44, the instruction after the call, while SP stays 0x7FF0 in the PCB.

spec.title: PID 1042 blocks on read()
spec.aria: A column of five boxes for Running, read() blocks, Waiting, Ready and Dispatched, joined by arrows labelled system call, card is slow, transfer done and scheduler picks; the Waiting and Ready boxes are highlighted, and the saved PC changes from 0x2A40 to 0x2A44.
